title: Podcast Scraper — LLM cost (#804)
description: LLM calls, tokens and spend from the pipeline's llm_cost events (#804), in VictoriaLogs. Each query reads both the event lines shipped before the Alloy unwrap stage (JSON behind the log prefix, extracted here) and after it (fields). Spend is $0 on self-hosted models.

targets.expr: instance:prod-podcast AND surface:pipeline AND (event_type:llm_cost OR "\"event_type\": \"llm_cost\"") | extract_regexp `(?P<ev>\{"ts": .*\})` | unpack_json from ev | stats by (provider) count() calls

instance:prod-podcast AND surface:pipeline AND (event_type:llm_cost OR "\"event_type\": \"llm_cost\"") | extract_regexp `(?P<ev>\{"ts": .*\})` | unpack_json from ev | stats sum(prompt_tokens) prompt_tokens, sum(completion_tokens) completion_tokens

instance:prod-podcast AND surface:pipeline AND (event_type:llm_cost OR "\"event_type\": \"llm_cost\"") | extract_regexp `(?P<ev>\{"ts": .*\})` | unpack_json from ev | stats sum(estimated_cost_usd) usd

instance:prod-podcast AND surface:pipeline AND (event_type:llm_cost OR "\"event_type\": \"llm_cost\"") | extract_regexp `(?P<ev>\{"ts": .*\})` | unpack_json from ev | stats by (stage) count() calls, sum(prompt_tokens) prompt_tokens, sum(completion_tokens) completion_tokens, sum(estimated_cost_usd) usd | sort by (calls desc)

instance:prod-podcast AND surface:pipeline AND (event_type:llm_cost OR "\"event_type\": \"llm_cost\"") | extract_regexp `(?P<ev>\{"ts": .*\})` | unpack_json from ev | stats by (run_id) count() calls, sum(prompt_tokens) prompt_tokens, sum(estimated_cost_usd) usd | sort by (prompt_tokens desc) | limit 20

instance:prod-podcast AND surface:pipeline AND (event_type:llm_cost OR "\"event_type\": \"llm_cost\"") | extract_regexp `(?P<ev>\{"ts": .*\})` | unpack_json from ev | stats by (feed_id) count() calls, sum(prompt_tokens) prompt_tokens, sum(estimated_cost_usd) usd | sort by (prompt_tokens desc)
